title: The Wolves break apart
summary: Davey Richards’ jealousy destroys his partnership with Eddie Edwards. Their wives become active participants as a friendship turns into a family feud.

chapters.title: Richards costs Edwards the title
chapters.result: Davey betrays Eddie during his world-title match with Lashley.
chapters.context: Richards pulls the referee out and attacks Edwards with the belt. Angelina Love helps turn the betrayal into a conflict involving both couples.

chapters.title: Full Metal Mayhem settles the score
chapters.result: Eddie and Alisha defeat Davey and Angelina.
chapters.context: The mixed tag-team brawl gives the Edwards family its major payoff after months of attacks and interference.
